question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A person's entire collection of clothes.
solution:
The correct solution is **"Wardrobe".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Let us see the meanings of the given options**__:

 
 
• **Dowry** is a **payment, such as property or money, paid by the bride's family to the groom or his family at the time of marriage**(दहेज)
 
• **Closet**: a **large cupboard that is built in to a room*****(***कमरे में लगी बड़ी अलमारी).
 
• **Attire**: **clothes**(वस्‍त्र, कपड़े, पोशाक)
 
• **Wardrobe**: ***a person’s collection of clothes***(व्‍यकि्त के निजी कपड़ों का संग्रह)

 
 
 
 
• **Therefore**, with the meaning of each and every word in the given options, we are sure that the most appropriate word for the given group of words is**' Wardrobe'.**
 
• The correct answer is **option 4.**

3d:T981,

The erroneous spelling is** "Fullfil".**
